---

## 中文原文

你在超市采购，拎着满满两大袋东西回家。走到半路袋子破了，水果和零食掉了一地，你手忙脚乱地蹲下来捡。

## My translation

I went shopping at supermarket, then headed home carrying two bags of stuff. On the half way, the bags were broken, so fruits and snacks dropped all over the place, I had to pick them up at a hurry.

## Revised version

I went shopping at the supermarket and headed home carrying two bags of groceries. Halfway there, the bags tore open. Fruit and snacks spilled everywhere, so I had to pick everything up in a hurry.

## Key phrases

- **groceries**：食品杂物
- **halfway there**：走到半路
- **tore open**：袋子裂开
- **spilled everywhere**：东西散落一地
- **in a hurry**：固定搭配
